rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Significant unexpected $30M+ operating loss in first 3 quarters of FY17 from Centegra Hospital-Huntley opening (128 beds, August 2016) failing to ramp; uncompensated care rise. Downgrade to BBB- (one notch above non-IG)
Definitive agreement to be acquired by Northwestern Medicine signed May 2018; Fitch placed BBB- on Rating Watch Negative — would face multi-notch downgrade if deal delayed/falls through

Acquisition by Northwestern Medicine closed September 1, 2018. Centegra absorbed into Northwestern Medicine credit envelope (Northwestern Memorial HealthCare Aa2 Moody's / AA+ Fitch). Legacy Fitch rating likely withdrawn post-merger

fitch._warning: Legacy Centegra Fitch BBB- rating likely withdrawn post September 2018 merger close as bonds absorbed/refunded into Northwestern Memorial parent (AA+ Fitch)

outcome_class_rationale: Centegra trajectory was deteriorating sharply — Fitch one-notch downgrade May 2017 from BBB to BBB- on Huntley losses, then RWN May 2018 indicating multi-notch downgrade if merger failed. Acquired by Northwestern Medicine Sept 2018 — bondholder outcome strongly positive: legacy BBB- absorbed into AA+ (Fitch) parent. Treated as ACQUIRED_UPGRADE despite the standalone deterioration that preceded it.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: FY2016 operating profit $4.3M = ~0.9% margin per Modern Healthcare ($500.6M revenue over 3-year period growing 15%). $325M Fitch-rated bonds outstanding. Centegra Hospital-Huntley opened August 2016 — capital project late-FY16, ramp issues materialized FY2017
